explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration for surjectivity of the sections comparison on compact opens. Searches for sheaf-section colimit preservation, compact-open sections comparisons, and filtered-colimit results in sheaf files found only related general results (such as global sections on local sites), which do not imply this theorem in one or two short lines. The proof uses this library’s own local-preimage and injectivity lemmas and gives a substantive gluing argument.
